```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-mpg

mpg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Highway Fuel Efficiency by Engine Size",
    subtitle = "Larger engines generally have lower highway fuel economy",
    x = "Engine Displacement (L)",
    y = "Highway MPG",
    color = "Vehicle Class",
    caption = "Source: EPA fuel economy data (ggplot2::mpg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
